summary: Frontend E2E testing of GLC Zone CRM+ERP. Login, dashboard, and all 13 modules verified. Fixed 2 CRITICAL React crashes on /crm/pipeline and /delivery (useEffect(load,[]) returning Promise caused 'destroy is not a function' pageerror, rendering blank page). After fix all pages load with sidebar. All core flows working: login, KPIs (10), 3 charts, vertical switcher, leads create, orders filter (20->2 for DELIVERED), invoice payment, run payroll (populates payroll-grid), tasks kanban with cards, notif bell, logout. Zero console errors after fix.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by test agent: useEffect(load, []) where load returns Promise crashed page - React interpreted Promise as cleanup fn ('destroy is not a function'). Entire /crm/pipeline route rendered blank.
FIXED by test agent: same useEffect(load, []) Promise bug - /delivery rendered blank with no sidebar.

Dashboard: app-sidebar, app-topbar, kpi-grid (10 cards), chart-revenue, chart-sales-vertical, chart-funnel, vertical-switcher opens dropdown, glc-store option updates context

action_items: Align data-testids to spec OR update spec: add tasks-kanban wrapper testid, po-grid on Purchase Orders, attendance-grid on Attendance matrix, alias quotes-grid->quotations-grid, coa-grid->accounts-grid, deliveries-board->deliveries-grid
Consider aliasing sidebar nav testids for compound labels (nav-pipeline, nav-tickets, nav-audit, nav-accounts, nav-gst) to match spec convention
Review other useEffect(load,[]) patterns for future - fixed 2 but confirm expression-body load functions are wrapped in arrow function
critical_code_review_comments: useEffect(load, []) anti-pattern: when load = () => api.get().then(...), it returns a Promise; React uses return value as cleanup. Caused runtime crash. Prefer useEffect(() => { load(); }, []).
Many list wrappers lack a stable data-testid at the container level (see tasks-kanban, po-grid, attendance-grid) which limits E2E testability.
